items.text: In this team, I can raise concerns without fear of embarrassment.
In this team, I can acknowledge a mistake without losing others' respect.
In this team, I can ask for help without being judged as less capable.
In this team, I can express disagreement without being treated poorly.
In this team, admitting uncertainty would damage my reputation.
In this team, questioning others' opinions would put my acceptance at risk.
In this team, sharing an unpopular idea would expose me to ridicule.
